title: The 2026 Florida Statutes, Title X, Chapter 121 — Florida Retirement System
verified_how: fetched the register chapter page: 'The 2026 Florida Statutes', heading 'CHAPTER 121 FLORIDA RETIREMENT SYSTEM', with parts 'GENERAL PROVISIONS (ss. 121.011-121.40)', 'FLORIDA RETIREMENT SYSTEM INVESTMENT PLAN (ss. 121.4501-121.5912)' and 'FLORIDA RETIREMENT SYSTEM CONTRIBUTION RATES (ss. 121.70-121.78)'.
notes: Florida has no auto-IRA or private-sector retirement mandate, so the FRS (covering state, county, school-district and many municipal employees) is the state's principal pension statute. Old-age and survivors insurance is federal (42 U.S.C. ch. 7).
